method: Unmodified upstream scan.mjs; full employer descriptions assessed by Codex using the Career Ops five-dimension rubric. These are agent-assisted assessments, not output from its API evaluator. Native 1–5 ratings are holistic, not converted from Nextmove match percentages.
refresh: Employer discovery runs daily at 9 AM IST in GitHub Actions. Codex evaluation runs separately on this Mac; review freshness is shown independently. Unconfirmed or stale vacancies are hidden.

recommendations.rationale: Python, Robot Framework, Selenium, API testing and test-strategy ownership align with the full description. Remote India is explicit. Performance tools remain a gap; this is an IC role and the data-product domain is new.

dimensions.name: CV match
dimensions.evidence: Python, Robot Framework, Selenium, API testing and test-strategy ownership align with the full description. Remote India is explicit. Performance tools remain a gap; this is an IC role and the data-product domain is new.

dimensions.name: North Star alignment
dimensions.evidence: Product employer and requested location fit. Individual-contributor scope does not meet the manager preference; ₹25L+ budget is unverified.

dimensions.name: Compensation
dimensions.evidence: No employer-disclosed annual total CTC range; ₹25L+ is not established.

dimensions.name: Cultural signals
dimensions.evidence: Employer descriptions are self-reported; independent team-level working conditions are not established.

dimensions.name: Red flags
dimensions.evidence: Exact employer application route is active. Specialist skill gaps and unknown compensation remain checks before applying; no assurance of hiring outcome.

exclusions.reason: Manager role requires 12+ QA years and BI/cloud/AI platform experience; dated experience is about 9.5 years. Senior role requires hands-on AI/ML testing not evidenced.
Mandatory RF/L1, current Wi-Fi technologies and lab-scale expertise are not sufficiently established.
Other discovered roles require deeper cloud/performance/security or data-centre/5G expertise, or advertise a lower experience band.
LabVIEW, NI TestStand and industrial instrumentation gaps.
Manufacturing inspection or chemical QA, rather than software testing.
